html:
Wawula is the name the map gives to an Aboriginal people of inland Western Australia, in desert country between the upper Fortescue and the lakes north of Wiluna. Little is written about them under this name, and it may be an older spelling for a group now known by another name.

Their neighbours on the map include the Martu peoples to the east and the Nyamal to the north. Like other desert peoples of Aboriginal Australia, they would have lived in small family bands that moved between waterholes, hunting and gathering seeds.
